clips.label: A Seed for the Sea — full piece
clips.note: Last pool → dormant flower → living sea → a tree in the boat
clips.details:
A red boat and luminous pearl connect a dry world to a new sea. The final scene lets the pearl sprout into a floating garden. Movement follows the painted river and flower, then curls/pulls back into a new world and travels across the water. The boat does not literally leave the original shell; it returns as a recurring motif. Small details still redraw.

Same-model Krea Turbo opening and recurrent repainting of the warped previous painting. CFG 1, three Euler intervals, independent recorded seeds and scene-specific noise ramps. Source cadence 12 at 24 fps; delivery runs 1.5× faster, still at 24 fps, retaining three paintings per displayed second. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 fills the intervals outside generation. The final seven frames continue spatial warping.
